# Compliance ticket for opi-q5k.11

Source check: opi-q5k.11 (overlay-non-capturing.test.ts audit)

## Nature of the gap

Upstream tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/overlay-non-capturing.test.ts verifies an entire subsystem (overlay focus lifecycle + input routing) that has no Elixir equivalent. Our `OctoPi.TUI.Overlay` is pure positioning/compositing with no lifecycle or focus concept.

Porting the tests requires implementing:

1. **Focusable behavior/protocol** — any Component can opt in to receive handleInput (or an Elixir equivalent: `handle_input/2` callback on a new behaviour). A Focusable has an id/pid.
2. **Focus state** — the TUI (or whatever top-level process owns the overlay stack) tracks a single current focus target. Changes produce focus/unfocus callbacks on the relevant components.
3. **Overlay lifecycle** — `show_overlay(overlay, opts)` where `opts.capturing` defaults to `true`. `hide_overlay()` pops the topmost. `focus(overlay)` forces the overlay focused; `unfocus(overlay)` reverts to `preFocus`. `set_hidden(overlay, bool)` toggles visibility without removal.
4. **Input dispatch** — route keyboard input to the topmost focused capturable target; non-capturing overlays are transparent to routing even when on top; hidden overlays never receive input.
5. **Visual ordering** — default render order is creation order; focusing an overlay bumps it to the top; unfocus does NOT change the visual order until a different overlay is focused (this is a subtle upstream invariant — see upstream test "unfocus() does not change visual order until another overlay is focused").

## Relationship to other epics

This overlaps conceptually with opi-m4h (Phase 4.1 TUI parity). Before starting, grep for any in-progress focus-related work and coordinate. If existing code touches an "interactive" or "dialog" stack, extend it rather than fork.

## Tests to port (all 24 upstream `it(...)` blocks)

Enumerated in the opi-q5k.11 audit comment. The processing agent must re-read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/overlay-non-capturing.test.ts top-to-bottom and port every test, mapping upstream `Component`/`Focusable` fixtures to Elixir equivalents.

Given the size, the processing agent SHOULD split this compliance ticket into at least:
- lifecycle API (show_overlay, hide_overlay, set_hidden)
- focus / unfocus + preFocus stack
- input dispatch (routing with non-capturing skip)
- visual ordering with focus bumps
Each sub-ticket should block opi-q5k.1 (the acceptance gate) independently and the parent compliance ticket should close only when all 24 upstream tests have Elixir equivalents.

## Re-comparison (required)

After implementation + all 24 tests land, re-read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/overlay-non-capturing.test.ts top-to-bottom and confirm every `it(...)` block has an Elixir equivalent that verifies the same invariant. Post a final comment here before closing.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate).
title: Implement overlay focus + capturing model, port overlay-non-capturing.test.ts (24 tests)
